config_description: Chess tools with accurate descriptions: three Elo-rated move generators

tools.name: elo_1200
tools.description: Analyzes the current board position and returns a suggested move in algebraic notation. The tool automatically reads the board state — no input is needed. Suggested move is calculated at 1200 Elo strength.
